data_with_no_home.description: The FY2025 Gross Rental Income by Property donut chart (p.41) labels 'Il•lumina' at 3.9% and 'Darmstadt Campus' at 0.1%. Il·lumina was divested in January 2024 and cannot have contributed 3.9% of FY2025 GRI. The property card for Darmstadt Campus (p.49) shows GRI €1.9m (approx 3.8% of €50.4m) vs the chart's 0.1%. These labels appear to be swapped or mislabelled in the report's chart. Extraction used per-property card figures as authoritative.
Germany NPI EUR 10,753k; Spain NPI EUR 5,816k; France NPI EUR 16,255k (p.193). These are the only NPI disclosures. No per-property NPI available.

German Portfolio EUR 200.8m (Jul 2029); Decathlon Portfolio EUR 51.4m (Jul 2027); Spanish Portfolio EUR 63.5m (Dec 2026); B&M Portfolio EUR 38.4m (Sep 2028); Fixed Rate Green Notes (Berlin Campus) EUR 56.4m/SGD 85m (May 2028). Total gross borrowings EUR 410.5m as at 31 Dec 2025.

Berlin Campus 0% occupied, undergoing conversion to mixed-use hospitality/office. Two 20-year hospitality leases signed (Premier Inn and Stayery) covering ~24% NLA. Phase 1 construction began 2Q2025. EUR 22.8m capex incurred in FY2025. SGD 85m fixed rate green notes issued May 2025 to partly finance repositioning.
Former Berlin Campus tenant DRV filed a EUR 8.4m legal claim in H1 2025 contesting dilapidation costs. No provision recorded as at 31 Dec 2025. Court filing still pending.

Berlin Campus valuation assumes (i) lease finalisation with major prospective office tenant (ii) refurbishment cost as provided by Manager (iii) no construction cost/risk adjustment. These are special assumptions per the valuer.

Individual GRI disclosed on property cards: Laval EUR 459k; Mâcon EUR 665k; Sens EUR 265k; Verdun EUR 253k; Vichy EUR 321k; Istres EUR 307k; Lannion EUR 330k; Gap EUR 323k; Foix EUR 347k. Portfolio total EUR 9.2m. Not fully extracted for all 27 properties.

Reporting currency is EUR throughout the consolidated financials. SGD exposure disclosed: Group assets SGD equivalent EUR 1,971k, liabilities EUR 57,875k (related to SGD 85m fixed rate green notes) as at 31 Dec 2025 (p.212). No explicit EUR/SGD or EUR/USD spot rate disclosed in the report.
Individual B&M property GRI not fully extracted. B&M portfolio total GRI EUR 7.2m (p.79). 17 properties with 100% occupancy. Lease WALE 5.9 years.

property_gross_revenue.basis: Property cards disclose 'Gross Rental Income' which is a mix of pure rental income and (for German/Spanish offices) includes service charges in the headline GRI figure. Per-property card GRI sums to EUR 41,728k. Portfolio overview disclosures sum to EUR 41.7m (Germany overview €17.8m + Spain portfolio overview €7.5m + Decathlon portfolio p.63 €9.2m + B&M portfolio p.79 €7.2m = €41.7m). These agree within 0.07% (pure rounding). Performance.gross_revenue = EUR 50,434k is TOTAL gross revenue including service charge income (EUR 8,412k), carpark income (EUR 2,626k), and other income (EUR 277k). The card GRI figures represent rental income plus service-charge elements rolled into the headline GRI, which is a different basis from Note 3.2 rental income (EUR 39,119k). The reconciliation here is at the card GRI granularity.
property_gross_revenue.note: property.gross_revenue = card 'Gross Rental Income' (not Note 3.2 'Rental income' which is 39,119k). The 8,706k gap to performance.gross_revenue = service charge income (8,412k) + carpark (2,626k) + other (277k) = 11,315k; offset by embedded service charges in German/Spanish card GRI = ~2,609k. Data is internally consistent at card level.
